title: SPLASH BEVERAGE GROUP, INC. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-24
summary: Splash Beverage Group, Inc. filed a Form 8-K reporting multiple corporate events including amendments to settlement agreements extending payment deadlines, resignation of two board directors, a consulting agreement with former CEO Robert Nistico including stock option grants contingent on a potential acquisition, and a disputed default demand from Decathlon Alpha IV, L.P. for approximately $2.83 million under a 2020 Revenue Loan and Security Agreement.
key_points: Company entered amendments to settlement agreements with three prior investors on April 20, 2026, extending remaining settlement payments of $535,595 to June 1, 2026 with 12% interest
Directors Justin Yorke and Robert Nistico resigned from the Board on April 21 and April 24, 2026, respectively
Company signed a consulting agreement with Robert Nistico on April 23, 2026: $5,000/month for six months plus 250,000 stock options vesting contingent on Medterra CBD acquisition
Decathlon Alpha IV, L.P. issued a demand letter on April 20, 2026 claiming default under a 2020 Revenue Loan and Security Agreement, demanding $2,833,395.98 as of March 31, 2026
Company disputes the default claim and has initiated discussions with the Lender to defend its rights
Prior notices of default were delivered by the Lender on March 18, 2025 and April 8, 2025
